reason: @mapbox/node-pre-gyp@1.0.11 declares tar@^6.1.11, and the tar@6.x line is within the vulnerable range for GHSA-r292-9mhp-454m (uncontrolled recursion DoS in mapHas/filesFilter, fixed only at tar@7.5.21+). Overriding to a patched tar@7.x is a deliberate major-version bump above the parent's declared range because no patched 6.x release exists; tar's extract() API used by node-pre-gyp is stable across 6.x and 7.x.
exitCondition: Remove once @mapbox/node-pre-gyp ships a release that declares tar@^7 directly, or once canvas/pdfjs-dist drop the node-pre-gyp/tar dependency chain (e.g. pdfjs-dist stops requiring node canvas for this project's Node-side usage).
